summary_en: WATTS executed a block acquisition of 250,800 shares (1.9% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) via ToSTNeT-3 at 712 yen per share on October 13, 2026, as part of a 515,800-share framework (3.9%) capped at 400 million yen through February 18, 2027.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury stock and purchase of treasury stock through off-hours trading transactions (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On October 13, 2026, WATTS executed a treasury stock acquisition via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading. The company purchased 250,800 shares at 712 yen per share, equivalent to 1.9% of issued shares excluding treasury stock. This execution represents the first tranche of a broader board-authorized program approved on the same date, which permits acquisition of up to 515,800 shares (3.9% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 400 million yen through February 18, 2027.

The company stated that the acquisition serves two objectives: improving capital efficiency and enhancing shareholder returns. The purchase was conducted through a single off-hours trading order at the October 9, 2026 closing price of 712 yen, with results announced at 8:45 a.m. on October 13 after the transaction concluded.

Following completion of the ToSTNeT-3 purchase, WATTS plans to implement open-market acquisition via a trust arrangement for any remaining authorized shares within the 515,800-share limit and 400 million yen ceiling. The company indicated that acquired treasury stock will be used partly for cancellation and partly as consideration for restricted stock grants to executive officers and as an incentive mechanism to enhance employee engagement.
